title: ABC & Transition evidence record
description: One atomic piece of evidence from one source. Records that say the same thing share a finding_id.

finding_id.description: Groups records that make the same point. Blank until the merge step (prompts/04) assigns one. The count of records sharing a finding_id IS the strength of evidence — do not assign one loosely.

statement.description: One sentence, the claim itself, in neutral language. Not a topic label.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt supporting the statement. Anonymised: no names, no attributable roles.

actors.description: Who the finding concerns. From taxonomy.actors.

tags.description: From taxonomy.tags. Two to four is usually right. More than five means the statement is not specific enough.

source_id.description: Must exist in sources.csv. The build fails otherwise.

confidence.description: Set at record level as an initial judgement. Validated but not used. The band a reader sees is computed per finding_id from independent source groups, streams and countries (1-5, see data/taxonomy.json -> strength).
